snippet.title: Stones Keeper Director's Cut - Official 2.0 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Stones Keeper is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a distinctive hand-drawn world. Assemble a squad of unique warriors, command your own flying fortress, and lead the Order of the Griffin in a war for the future of the kingdom.

Stones Keeper Director's Cut is a revamped version of the game with upgraded visuals, new animations, and an overhauled story campaign.
